title: Ave Maria (Johannes Okeghem)
desc: Johannes Okeghem, Ave Maria. 4 voices (Discantus, Altus, Tenor, Bassus), each on its own staff. From the Josquin Research Project (josquin.stanford.edu, Oke2002); encoded by Jesse Rodin. CC BY-NC 4.0. Note values as in the edition (whole note = semibreve); coloured notes stand for the triplet groups; editorial accidentals small above the staff.
